page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn1.large is an x86_64 compute-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 4 dedicated Intel Xeon 8269CY physical cores operating at 2.5 GHz, with 1.0 thread per core. The system is configured with 8.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 2.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, relying entirely on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 1 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates that the ecs.sn1.large sits in the lower performance tiers. Both single-core and multi-core stress-ng CPU benchmarks place the instance in the bottom 25%. Memory bandwidth performance is constrained, with large-block read operations falling into the bottom 10% at 20.95 GB/sec and write operations in the bottom 25% at 18.75 GB/sec. Similarly, Geekbench scores for single-core and multi-core are in the bottom 10%, reflecting limited computational throughput for intensive tasks.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.sn1.large provides a dedicated CPU allocation at an entry-level hardware tier, making it a predictable option for workloads that require dedicated resources without the premium cost of high-performance instances. However, the tradeoffs include lower memory bandwidth and weak computational benchmarks. This makes the instance best suited for lightweight utility workloads, basic web serving, or small-scale development environments where high memory density and high-speed I/O are not required.
